title: Command Injection Vulnerability in MCP STDIO Transport
notes: Fixed by adding validateStdioCommand() that checks for shell metacharacters and validates command paths
close_reason: All security fixes implemented and verified. All tests passing.

title: Path Traversal Vulnerability in Agent File Operations
notes: Fixed by using filepath.EvalSymlinks to properly resolve symlinks and added Windows UNC path and drive letter validation
close_reason: All security fixes implemented and verified. All tests passing.

title: Integration tests overwrite the developer's REAL ~/.chatgpt-cli/config.yaml
description: test/integration/integration_test.go builds config paths from path.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), ".chatgpt-cli"). On Windows HOME=C:\Users\david, so running 'go test -run Integration' silently destroys the developer's live config.yaml (observed 2026-09-19: real config replaced with model: gpt-3.5-turbo-0301 / thread: thread-name / max_tokens: 789, causing a 404 on the next real 'gpt' invocation). Tests assert Expect(configFile).NotTo(BeAnExistingFile()), which assumes a throwaway HOME. Fix: point the suite at a t.TempDir()/OPENAI_CONFIG_HOME sandbox instead of HOME.
close_reason: Root cause: os.UserHomeDir() reads USERPROFILE on Windows, not HOME. The suite sandboxed only HOME, so the spawned CLI wrote to the developer's real profile. Now sets and restores both. Also fixed: hardcoded port 8080 (Windows allows a second bind over an existing listener -> connection races) replaced with an OS-assigned ephemeral port; POSIX-only path/error-string assertions made platform-neutral. Integration suite on Windows: 29 failures -> 0.

title: Sensitive Data Exposure via Insecure File Permissions
notes: Fixed by changing all sensitive file writes from 0644 to 0600 in history/store.go, config/store.go, cmd/chatgpt/utils/utils.go, and cmd/chatgpt/main.go
close_reason: All security fixes implemented and verified. All tests passing.

title: Unvalidated User Input in Shell Command Arguments
notes: Fixed by adding checks for shell variable expansion ($, `, %), glob patterns (*, ?, [), and tilde expansion anywhere in arguments
close_reason: All security fixes implemented and verified. All tests passing.

title: Update default model: gpt-4o retired-era default -> gpt-5.5; user config -> gpt-5.3-codex
description: The configured model gpt-5.2-codex now returns HTTP 404 'does not exist or you do not have access to it'. The repo's hardcoded default is still gpt-4o (config/store.go, cmd/chatgpt/main.go). Bump both to currently-supported models, update affected tests and docs.
close_reason: Default model bumped gpt-4o -> gpt-5.5; user config gpt-5.2-codex -> gpt-5.3-codex. Both verified working against the live API.

title: Race Condition in Config File Updates
notes: Fixed by implementing atomic write pattern: write to temp file, sync, then atomically rename to prevent race conditions
close_reason: All security fixes implemented and verified. All tests passing.

title: Missing Input Validation for API Key File Path
notes: Fixed by adding validateAPIKeyFilePath() that checks file size (max 10KB), validates path is within home/config directory, and sanitizes error messages
close_reason: All security fixes implemented and verified. All tests passing.

title: Unbounded Memory Allocation in Agent Transcript
notes: Fixed by adding maxOutputStreamBytes constant (32KB) and truncating stdout, stderr, and LLM prompt/output before appending to transcripts
close_reason: All security fixes implemented and verified. All tests passing.

title: Track upstream: gpt-4o-era defaults and Completions-only mock server
description: Repo default model moved gpt-4o -> gpt-5.5, which routes via /v1/responses instead of /v1/chat/completions. Mock server gained a postResponses handler + test/data/responses.json. If upstream kardolus/chatgpt-cli changes either, reconcile on merge.
